notes.title: Join Pro Basketball Manager's 2016's Closed Beta!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.basketball-pro-management.com/cache/img/l/jpg/c/0/closedbeta-1.jpg[/img]

[b]Pro Basketball Manager 2016, our new ultra realistic basketball management game, will be released next january![/b]

You want to be the first to try it and help the team to polish the game? Join the Closed Beta that will start mid-october!

All you have to do is to fill the form at this adress >> https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1dEdJhI7QmsCngSH0leVrPSxx2HnHKpd1L_DiYxb9jPU/viewform?c=0&w=1

More info about Pro Basketball Manager 2016 here: http://www.pro-basketball-manager.com/

notes.title: Your opinion counts! / Votre avis nous intéresse !
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Tzm3xpd.jpg[/img]

You played Basketball Pro Management 2015? We are interested in your opinion! 
Please take few minutes to fill our online survey and help us to build the next edition of the game. 

Answer here for the english version >> https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FXOBoOtk1mK7plk4tmf5HzF7EXibIvYskbQDaacwh48/viewform
--

notes.title: [VIDEO] How to create a System / Play
notes.notes:
Did you know that Basketball Pro Management 2015 includes an editor that allows you to create your own game systems?

Here is a tutorial video showing you how to make your own plays in order to use them in game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-WW2Tyhb5nY
